title: 第23章 等一下
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳心里想着：看你还怎么演，这下总该露馅吧。

    苏冰抬头看向陈阳，眼中充满了震撼和愤怒，心里暗暗发誓：小子，你要是真的负了我苏家，我定要你死！

    她深吸一口气，伸出手，缓缓解起陈阳的裤子纽扣。

    陈阳看着苏冰的动作，再次傻眼，心中震惊不已：怎么会这样？她竟然真的照做了？

    眼看苏冰的手就要解开陈阳的裤子，就在这时，办公室的房门突然被敲响。

    杨婷的声音从门外传来：“总裁，黄金龙副总带着赵凯主管来找您，说有急事，想跟您面谈。”

    苏冰听到声音，脸色瞬间冷了下来，对着门外沉声说：“让他们在外面等着。”

    “是，总裁。”杨婷应声退下。

    办公室外，听到这话的黄金龙和赵凯，脸色瞬间变得复杂。

    黄金龙是个中年男人，头顶有些秃顶，穿着一身黑色西装，脸上带着几分油腻，他转头看向赵凯，眼神里满是疑惑。

    赵凯则皱起眉头，心里纳闷：总裁怎么让他们在外面等着？里面到底在干什么？

    办公室内。

    陈阳看着苏冰的动作，瞬间感觉全身像被施了定身穴一样，动弹不得，眼睛直勾勾地盯着她，心跳不由自主地加快。

    办公室里一时安静得可怕。

    明明开着空调，温度适宜，但陈阳却感觉全身像着火一样，燥热难耐，额头上渗出了细密的汗珠。

    办公室外，赵凯等了一会，见办公室门还没开，心里有些不耐烦。

    他转头看向杨婷，语气带着一丝讨好：“杨秘书，总裁怎么还不让我们进去？有急事呢，耽误了事情可不好。”

    杨婷冷冷地看了他一眼，眼神里带着一丝不屑。

    赵凯被她这么一看，心里有些发毛，但还是连忙挤出笑容，不敢再多问。
content_en:
Chen Yang thought to himself: It depends on how you act, the secret should be exposed now.

Su Bing looked up at Chen Yang, her eyes full of shock and anger, and she secretly swore in her heart: Boy, if you really betray my Su family, I will kill you!

She took a deep breath, stretched out her hand, and slowly lifted the button of Chen Yang's pants.

Chen Yang looked at Su Bing's actions and was dumbfounded again, shocked in his heart: How could this happen?She actually did it?

Just as Su Bing was about to unbutton Chen Yang's pants, there was a sudden knock on the office door.

Yang Ting's voice came from outside the door: "President, Vice President Huang Jinlong came to you with Director Zhao Kai, saying that there is something urgent and he wants to interview you."

Su Bing's face instantly turned cold when she heard the sound, and she said in a deep voice to the door: "Let them wait outside."

"Yes, President." Yang Ting stepped back.

Outside the office, Huang Jinlong and Zhao Kai's expressions instantly became complicated when they heard this.

Golden Dragon was a middle-aged man with a bald head, wearing a black suit, and his face was a little greasy. He turned to look at Zhao Kai, his eyes full of doubts.

Zhao Kai frowned and wondered: Why did the CEO let them wait outside?What's going on inside?

Inside the office.

Chen Yang looked at Su Bing's movements and instantly felt as if his whole body had been stabbed. He couldn't move. His eyes were staring at her, and his heartbeat accelerated involuntarily.

The office was eerily quiet for a moment.

The air conditioner was obviously on and the temperature was suitable, but Chen Yang felt like his whole body was on fire. It was unbearably hot and there were beads of sweat on his forehead.

Outside the office, Zhao Kai waited for a while and felt a little impatient when he saw that the office door had not yet opened.

He turned to look at Yang Ting, with a hint of flattery in his tone: "Secretary Yang, why doesn't the president let us in? It's urgent. It's not good to delay things."

Yang Ting gave him a cold look, with a hint of disdain in her eyes.

Zhao Kai felt a little frightened when she saw him like this, but he still squeezed out a smile and didn't dare to ask any more questions.
